title: Steampunk Airship Over the Clouds
description: Build a Victorian-era airship scene with brass details, dramatic clouds, and golden hour lighting. Strong fit for book covers and fantasy game art.

prompt.main: majestic victorian steampunk airship with brass propellers and copper boilers floating through dramatic golden hour clouds, intricate gear mechanisms visible, billowing smoke from twin smokestacks, detailed hull plating, oil painting atmosphere, howl's moving castle inspired --ar 16:9 --v 6.1 --s 800
prompt.negative: --no modern elements, plastic, anime, clean lines, minimalist

explained.why: High stylize lets MJ add intricate mechanical detail. Steampunk lives or dies on texture density.
v6.1 handles "brass/copper/gear" terminology much better than v5.2.
Cinematic widescreen ratio suits sky-bound compositions. Use 1:1 for character-focused steampunk portraits.

tutorial.intro: Steampunk is detail-driven. Generic "steampunk" gets you Victorian boots; "brass propellers + copper boilers + gear mechanisms" gets you a real airship.
steps: Anchor subject: majestic victorian steampunk airship — name the era (victorian) and vehicle (airship).
Add materials: brass propellers, copper boilers, detailed hull plating — these three push MJ from "balloon" to "steampunk vessel".
Specify mechanics: intricate gear mechanisms visible, billowing smoke from twin smokestacks — mechanical cues sell the genre.
Set atmosphere: dramatic golden hour clouds, oil painting atmosphere — natural lighting + painterly style = epic mood.
Reference: howl's moving castle inspired — naming a specific Ghibli film gives MJ a visual target.
tutorial.tips: Steampunk = brass + copper + gears + Victorian + steam. Without these five keywords, you get a balloon with random pipes.

crossModel.midjourney: Use rewrite prompt with --s 800. Add --chaos 15 for mechanical variation.

faq.q: Why does my steampunk image look modern?
faq.a: You forgot the "victorian" and "brass/copper" keywords. Without them, MJ defaults to "futuristic".

faq.q: How to get more mechanical detail?
faq.a: Raise --s to 800+ and add "intricate gear mechanisms, pipes, rivets". MJ v6.1 reads these terms well.

faq.q: Best aspect ratio for cover art?
faq.a: 16:9 for video/YouTube. 2:3 for book covers. 1:1 for thumbnails.
